# α3.13d — An idea remains their own

## What is new

A person can dream of an action they handled and a benefit they experienced. It is a guess: needs, available materials and ordinary chance still decide. Place and idea dreams share the nightly limits. Your dreams records the actual later attempt and result; the person's card contains no player attribution.

Format 5 refuses earlier builds' saves. Start a new camp; no conversion is performed. Paused shared lessons now preserve another person's unfinished drink/rest, fixing a strict-reader save failure.

## What to try

Hold an eligible person → Idea from a memory → Recall warmth they felt → Send dream. Save while queued, reopen, advance through sleep, then inspect Your dreams and the person's next try. Watching alone is not handling. Cancel and Back leave no request.

These were fixed, then the failed sections passed separately; no whole-routine PASS is claimed. Tool tests: 165 in 45.60 s; final native CTest: 86.90 s. File/ID checks passed.

## What is rough

Not release-signed: built in check mode; release signing waits for the owner's passphrase.

Paired conditional scenes retain both sets: first 20 gave 17 relevant tries, fresh 20 gave 20; ALL40 **37/40 ≥30 passes**. Actual success is separate: 14 sleepers, 16 successes. No-sent and missing-input controls produced zero matching tries; absent material stayed absent. These begin with real short twirling and experienced warmth, and do not prove natural discovery frequency.

Retained reopen acceptance **failed**: first-set controls incorrectly removed the hearth's backing item; fresh seed 221 exposed a paused-lesson save bug. Both are repaired with regressions. The failed results are preserved; no third set or rejudging. Fresh closing proofs in α3.13e must establish the current build.

Touched native tests: 14 cases/1,134 assertions, 14.51 s. App route and journal failure/cut tests pass. Peak memory after removing the diagnostic snapshot accumulation: paired seed 50.2 MiB (8.22 s); all 297 then-current native tests 122.3 MiB (57.46 s). The retained 40 pairs took 182.31 s total. Hardware performance, phone/cloud end digests, sustained battery/heat, owner play answers, the failed b spread gate and independent milestone review remain open.
